meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪短篇网文热门趋势，发现风口题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是短篇网文作者，想快速掌握平台热门题材
copy.tagline_en: Track short story trends and discover viral topics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short web novels and want to catch trending themes

howto.what: 它扫描知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台的短篇小说榜单，分析当前热门的情绪类型、题材、篇幅、开头模式和结尾偏好，产出一份带风口预警和写作方向的扫榜报告。
howto.when: 当你输入“/story-short-scan”“/短篇扫榜”或说“短篇什么火”等触发词，或提出要分析短篇小说市场时触发。

say.note: 会按默认平台开始扫榜概览。

say.text: 帮我扫榜知乎盐言，看看虐恋题材还行吗？
say.note: 会针对该平台做深度扫榜。

say.text: 对比七猫和黑岩的短篇风口。

howto.what_en: It scans short-story charts on Zhihu Yanyan, Qimao, Heiyan, Dianzhong and other platforms, analyzes popular emotional types, themes, word counts, opening patterns and ending preferences, and produces a scan report with trend alerts and writing directions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you enter "/story-short-scan", "/短篇扫榜", say "短篇什么火" etc., or ask to analyze the short-fiction market.

say_en.note: Starts a general scan of the default platform.

say_en.text: Scan Zhihu Yanyan—are sad romance themes still hot?
say_en.note: Runs a deep scan for that platform.

say_en.text: Compare short-story trends on Qimao and Heiyan.
